prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished, production-quality high-fidelity desktop web app screenshot for ACT Study Lab, a redesigned four-subject ACT learning product. A game-like learning path inspired by Duolingo's motivation combined with Brilliant's hands-on educational clarity, but an original identity, not a clone. This is a real web UI design, not a poster or photo. Render one complete flat front-on desktop viewport 1536x1024, edge to edge, no device frame, no browser chrome, no collage, no perspective. Large crisp meticulously aligned legible UI text, plenty of breathing room, a warm rounded humanist sans (Nunito Sans-like). Cool white and very pale blue surfaces, ink navy #172442 text, saturated cobalt #3556EE primary, fresh lime #C7EE78 success, lilac #BCA6FF, coral #FF9D88 as controlled subject accents. Confident round 14px corners and pressable buttons with subtle 3px bottom edges. Fine clean geometric subject icons and precise functional educational diagrams. No gradients, glassmorphism, cartoon mascot, empty decorative art, trophies dominating the page, gimmick currency, or dark mode. Clear contrast and accessible large targets. Brand text exactly "ACT Study Lab" with a simple four-piece geometric mark. Main nav labels "Today", "Course", "Practice", "Progress", "Settings". Include test-date planning "Test day · Dec 12" and "60 min/day" plus understated "Edit plan". All times are approximate planning estimates, never countdowns. Include a tiny bottom label "Example plan" so sample progress is honest. Show all four subject names English, Math, Reading, Science. Original short educational content only. Current Math lesson example: a bike rental costs $3 to start plus $2 per hour, formula C = 3 + 2h. A correct graph has Hours on x, Total cost ($) on y and points (0,3), (1,5), (2,7), (3,9), (4,11), with line starting at (0,3). Draw clean exact axes and coherent plot.
COMPOSITION B — QUEST BOARD. Same identity as a modern tactile educational game: restrained cobalt/navy, cool white, lime/lilac/coral. Build a 1536x1024 first viewport, no outer margin or browser chrome. Top horizontal header 90px with ACT Study Lab left; Today selected, Course, Practice, Progress centered; small "3 day streak" and Settings right. Main area with generous 64px side padding. Main heading "A plan that moves with you." in 36px navy. Under it one quiet line "Test day · Dec 12   /   60 min/day" with Edit plan on the right.
The main focal structure is a big four-subject daily board, not a sidebar and not a winding path. A top full-width cobalt-blue next-lesson banner has white text "UP NEXT · MATH", headline "Starting cost + each hour", secondary "~15 min · Learn, explore, practice". Right of the banner one large white button with cobalt type "Continue →". Under banner four generous rectangular subject panels in a precise 2x2 grid, with lots of actual educational content and distinct state. Top-left pale lime English panel: label "ENGLISH", heading "Connect two ideas", two crisp sentence tiles "Although it rained" and "we kept walking." joined by a larger comma tile; small checkmark and "Completed" at bottom. Top-right white Math panel, cobalt outline: label "MATH", heading "See the pattern", a coherent small coordinate graph showing cost C=3+2h with points (0,3), (1,5), (2,7), keep the graph sparse and correct, footer "Ready to continue". Bottom-left very pale lilac Reading panel: label "READING", heading "Find the evidence", three readable short passage lines "Mina slowed down at the uneven rhythm." highlighted in lilac and "She marked two bars to practice tomorrow."; small "Tap the clue" pill. Bottom-right very pale coral Science panel: label "SCIENCE", heading "Change one thing", two tidy side-by-side diagram trays A and B with simple seedlings and labels "Same water", "Different fertilizer". Diagram is precise flat educational vector-like, not childish painting. Footer across main "Today: 1 of 4 lessons complete" as small text with four short progress segments, and small "Example plan". Attractive maturity for high school students, no mascot, no giant score claim or competitive leaderboard. No inset mini browser windows. Headings should be easy to scan. All panels' core educational content is crisp, not decorative filler.
editPrompt: Edit this existing ACT Study Lab UI mockup. Keep the entire layout, typography, colors, all other panels, and every other text unchanged. Only correct the bottom-right Science panel to show an accurate controlled-experiment setup. Both trays must contain same-sized seedlings of the same species. The small label above the two trays should read "Same water". Under tray A use exactly two lines: "4 mg fertilizer/day" then "20 mL water/day". Under tray B use exactly two lines: "0 mg fertilizer/day" then "20 mL water/day". Remove the previous "Regular fertilizer", "High-nitrogen fertilizer", and "Different fertilizer" labels. The question below the trays must read exactly "Which variable changes?" instead of predicting which plants grow taller. Maintain all original panel sizes, spacing, color, and the original Science heading "Change one thing". No other changes.
purpose: User-requested mockup before implementation; illustrative progress only.
